001package org.opt4j.tutorial.gatekeeper;
002
003import org.opt4j.core.start.Opt4JTask;
004import org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule;
005import org.opt4j.optimizers.ea.EvolutionaryAlgorithmModule;
006
007public class GatekeeperExample {
008    public static void main(String[] args) {
009        // The base problem and optimizer
010        ExpensiveMinOnesModule minOnes = new ExpensiveMinOnesModule();
011
012        EvolutionaryAlgorithmModule ea = new EvolutionaryAlgorithmModule();
013        ea.setGenerations(100);
014        ea.setPopulationSize(100);
015
016        // Configure the Gatekeeper (using default parameters)
017        NeuralGatekeeperModule gatekeeper = new NeuralGatekeeperModule();
018
019        // Run the Task
020        Opt4JTask task = new Opt4JTask(false);
021        task.init(ea, minOnes, gatekeeper);
022
023        try {
024            task.execute();
025        } catch (Exception e) {
026            e.printStackTrace();
027        } finally {
028            task.close();
029        }
030    }
031}
